description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Reward' class in the OpenCart admin extension for total rewards, defining its controller logic including index and save methods for managing reward settings.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing reward total extension in the OpenCart admin panel, providing index and save functionalities for the reward settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the reward extension settings page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the reward extension settings with permission check, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.
